kpis.name: Total Gross Sales
kpis.description: The total monetary value of all sales transactions recorded in the dataset.

kpis.name: Total Net Profit
kpis.description: The total financial gain remaining after all costs are subtracted from gross sales.

kpis.name: Net Profit Margin Percentage
kpis.description: The ratio of total profit to total sales, expressed as a percentage to measure overall efficiency.

kpis.name: Average Discount Rate
kpis.description: The mean discount applied across all transactions, used to monitor the impact of promotional pricing.

kpis.name: Total Order Volume
kpis.description: The count of unique order identifiers, representing the total number of customer transactions.

kpis.name: Average Order Value (AOV)
kpis.description: The average revenue generated per unique order, indicating customer spending behavior.

kpis.name: Profit per Order
kpis.description: The average net profit generated for every unique order processed.

kpis.name: Unique Product Count
kpis.description: The total number of distinct products sold, reflecting the breadth of the active inventory.
